products.description:
Make Google Cloud (and Workspace) spend visible, attributable, and controlled

Cloud spend without FinOps becomes a surprise bill nobody owns. This solution establishes FinOps for Google Cloud: billing export to BigQuery, cost attribution by folder/project/label, budgets and alerts, committed-use and rightsizing opportunities, and showback/chargeback dashboards — extendable to Workspace and Gemini licensing — so every dollar is visible, attributable, and governed.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run Python (gcloud / Cloud Client Libraries).

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the FinOps model: billing export, cost attribution (labels/hierarchy), budgets/alerts, optimization levers (CUD/rightsizing), and showback/chargeback.
  • Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (billing account + admin, hierarchy/labeling, BigQuery for export, stakeholders).
  • Implementation Guide — enable billing export to BigQuery, build attribution + dashboards, set budgets/alerts, identify CUD/rightsizing savings, and stand up a showback cadence — pilot-first.
  • 5 Python tools — assessment/discovery, a configuration or provisioning helper, a validation/report generator, a policy/guardrail check, and a scope/config helper — authentic gcloud / Cloud Client Library automation (read-only or dry-run by default; no credentials or keys in code).
  • Validation gates (spend attributable, budgets alerting, savings identified) plus Best Practices for an ongoing FinOps operating rhythm.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Google Cloud (and Workspace/Gemini) spend made visible, attributable, and controlled — budgets alerting, savings identified, showback in place — no more surprise bills.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • Automation Scripts (ZIP) — 6 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • finops-budget-provisioner.py — create/delete Cloud Billing budgets + alerts (dry-run by default)
    • finops-discovery.py — inventory the Cloud Billing / FinOps baseline (read-only)
    • finops-guardrail-check.py — validate the FinOps posture against the gates (read-only)
    • finops-report.py — emit BigQuery attribution views + report unattributed spend
    • finops-savings-analyzer.py — read rightsizing / idle / CUD recommendations into a savings backlog
    • finops-scope-helper.py — resolve & validate the FinOps scope into a reusable config (read-only)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all Python scripts and tools in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
